title: Check if Wi-Fi driver and interface are active
summary: Verify that the kernel has loaded the correct driver for your Wi-Fi card and that the wireless interface exists and is up.

steps.explain: List PCI devices and their kernel drivers to see if a driver is bound to the network controller.
List network interfaces to find the wireless interface name (usually starts with 'wl', e.g., wlan0 or wlp2s0).
Bring the wireless interface up. Replace <INTERFACE> with the name found in the previous step.

verify.expect: The interface state includes 'UP' in the flags (e.g., <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP>).
